notes: Verified starter for PPN and the core PPh withholding categories. This is not a filing position and not a complete rate engine. PPnBM percentages, the full monthly TER grid, PPh 22 percentages, and PPh 4(2) percentages are intentionally absent. Silence means not encoded, not zero. Windows marked in_force_by are verified on that date; the legal start may be earlier.

semantic_mappings.rule: BKP and JKP that take the generally applicable PPN rate. From 2025-01-01 this is 12% times DPP Nilai Lain 11/12 for supplies that are not Pasal 2 luxury goods. Do not map that 11/12 mechanism to reduced.
Exports of tangible BKP, intangible BKP, and JKP taxed at 0% under Pasal 7 ayat (2). This is not dibebaskan: the statutory explanation says related input VAT stays creditable.

A supply is exempt only when a government regulation grants fasilitas PPN dibebaskan under Pasal 16B. Input VAT on that supply is not creditable (Pasal 16B ayat (3)). Do not use this for Pasal 4A or for tidak dipungut.

VAT remains payable but is not collected, and only where a Pasal 16B facility says tidak dipungut. Input VAT on that supply can be credited (Pasal 16B ayat (2)). This is not an exemption and not a non-object.
Goods and services listed as not subject to VAT in Pasal 4A as amended by UU HPP. The negative list is closed. Older guides that still treat staples as non-objek are not a source for this code.

semantic_mappings.local_name: Pemanfaatan BKP tidak berwujud atau JKP dari luar Daerah Pabean
semantic_mappings.rule: The recipient self-assesses PPN on use of offshore intangible BKP or offshore JKP (Pasal 4 ayat (1) huruf d and e). From 2025-01-01 PMK 131 Pasal 3 puts this in the 11/12 base with the standard treatment.

semantic_mappings.local_name: PPN atas BKP mewah yang dikenai PPnBM
semantic_mappings.rule: From 2025-01-01, luxury BKP that are also subject to PPnBM take 12% on harga jual or nilai impor (PMK 131 Pasal 2). Do not use this for a final consumer during 1-31 January 2025; use ppn-luxury-final-consumer. PPnBM itself is a different tax and is not in this pack.

semantic_mappings.local_name: PPN BKP mewah kepada konsumen akhir
semantic_mappings.rule: PMK 131 Pasal 5: a luxury BKP supplied to a final consumer uses 12% times 11/12 from 2025-01-01 through 2025-01-31, and 12% on the selling price from 2025-02-01.

Monthly TER for a permanent employee or pensioner in a tax period that is not the last period. PTKP status selects kategori A, B, or C under PP 58/2023 Pasal 2. Their last period uses pph21-annual. The percentage grid is not transcribed here.

semantic_mappings.local_name: PPh 21 TER bulanan pegawai tidak tetap
semantic_mappings.rule: Monthly TER for a non-permanent employee who is paid monthly, including the last month of the year. Do not move this case to pph21-annual in December, and do not use the daily bands.

Daily TER for a non-permanent employee who is not paid monthly, within the two bands published for PP 58/2023: 0% up to Rp450,000 a day, and 0.5% above that up to Rp2,500,000 a day. A monthly-paid non-permanent employee stays on ter_bulanan_tidak_tetap even when average daily income falls in these bands. Amounts above Rp2,500,000 a day are not encoded.

Pasal 17 layers for the annual tax and for the last-period withholding of a permanent employee or pensioner. Layers are progressive on taxable income. A monthly-paid non-permanent employee is not moved onto this treatment for December.
Article 22 withholding by appointed collectors. Rates depend on the goods and the collector and are not encoded. Do not assume a single percentage.

Pasal 23 ayat (1) headline 15% of the gross amount on dividends, interest, royalties, and prizes paid to a resident taxpayer or permanent establishment. Exemptions, including the domestic-dividend rule, are not enumerated.

Pasal 23 ayat (1) headline 2% of the gross amount on rent other than land and/or buildings, and on compensation for technical, management, consulting, and other services. The Minister of Finance service list is not encoded.

Final tax on the income types named in Pasal 4 ayat (2). Each type has its own percentage in a government regulation or minister of finance regulation. This pack records the category and the filing codes only.
Statutory 20% withholding on the specified Indonesia-source income of a non-resident, unless a tax treaty sets a different rate. Treaty rates are not encoded.
